desc: Build the functional graph, identify connected components, and for each component, find the cycle and the trees rooted on the cycle nodes.

For each node, determine its position in the tree structure (children list) and process nodes in reverse topological order (leaves to root) to compute $f(u, k)$ for all $k \in [1, M]$. $f(u, k) = \prod_{v \in children(u)} f(v, k) \pmod{998244353}$. Base case: leaves have $f(u, k) = k$.
For each component, let the cycle nodes be $r_1, \dots, r_c$. The number of ways for this component given cycle value $v$ is $W_c(v) = \prod_{i=1}^c f(r_i, v)$.
Compute the total answer as $\sum_{v=1}^M \prod_{components} W_c(v) \pmod{998244353}$.
Implement the solution in Python, reading from stdin and printing to stdout.
